card.name: Verbs and particles of placement
card.fires_on: The word right after a verb of location, attachment or staying, such as live, falls off, combine with, in place. It marks where or how something sits or is attached.

modes.label: Verb of residing or attaching
modes.description: A verb or participle describing where something lives or is attached or removed.
modes.example: Bifidobacteria are a group of bacteria that normally<< live>> in the intestines.

modes.label: Particle after the verb
modes.description: A short particle or noun completing a phrase like falls off, in place, combined in.
modes.example: Leave pledgets in<< place>> for up to 20 minutes.
